data.current_description: The T-Mobile Order API v2 enables wireless service orders, including adding new lines, purchasing devices, and handling service actions such as restore, suspend, and cancel. It supports a wide range of order types—from use your own Device and SIM-only activations to full-price device bundles with rate plans and accessories—ensuring flexibility across consumer and business use cases.
data.description_suggestion: Submits a new wireless service order to T-Mobile, supporting device purchases, new line activations, service modifications (restore, suspend, cancel), and various order types including BYOD, SIM-only, and device bundles with rate plans and accessories. Accepts order details via request parameters and returns an order confirmation with order ID and status. Supports both synchronous (200) and asynchronous (202) processing responses.

data.current_description: To get detailed information about an order (including the final status, line details, tracking numbers, charges, etc.), use the /queryOrder endpoint. This endpoint returns a comprehensive view of the order.
